precondition.description: A purpose-bearing customer supplies one typed GoogleDriveUseRequest, receives the exact provider offer, and invokes it with a content-addressed, expiring, single-use capability bound to the same non-secret credential grant and effects.

postcondition.description: The customer receives one digest-bound product or typed refusal; the capability is consumed, provider requests and elapsed time are observed, unknown costs remain unknown-not-zero, and no credential material is recorded.

purposes.retrieve one file from Google Drive: one fixed files.get metadata request followed by one fixed bounded media request
